meta.title: Git commit / branch / merge mental model

zh-Hant.title: Git 提交／分支／合併心智模型
zh-Hant.honesty: 教學示意：工作區、暫存區、提交物件與分支指標。不是 git.git 內部實作，也不是證照保證。

en.title: Git commit / branch / merge mental model
en.honesty: Teaching sketch of working tree, index, commits, and branch pointers. Not git.git internals and not a certification.

views.label: Commit
views.note: git add copies a snapshot into the index; git commit writes a commit object and moves the current branch.

views.label: Branch
views.note: A branch name is a movable pointer to a commit, not a full copy of the tree.

views.label: Merge
views.note: merge joins two histories. Fast-forward may only move a pointer; a merge commit appears when histories diverged.

messages.label: 8. git merge feature ➜ merge commit M

cards.title: Commit is a snapshot
items: A commit points at a tree (the staged snapshot) and its parent commit(s).
git commit moves the current branch pointer; it does not store a patch as the primary object.

cards.title: Branch is a pointer
items: feature and main are names that point at commits.
Creating a branch does not copy the working tree; it adds another pointer.

cards.title: Merge joins histories
items: When histories diverged, merge creates a commit with two parents.
If main can fast-forward to feature, Git may only move the pointer — no extra merge commit.
